name: Retrieval for Mauren
summary: In Stormwind, Collin Mauren asks travelers bound for Kalimdor to bring rare basilisk scales. He wants scales from the Charred Vale in Stonetalon, ground to dust for his spellcraft.

sections.title: A Mage's Curious Reagents
sections.body: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, wizard Collin Mauren listens to tales from wandering adventurers. He has heard that travelers venture deep into Kalimdor, where Stonetalon draws those seeking wild wyverns, unruly elementals, or dealings and clashes with the Venture Company. Mauren seeks neither riches nor glory. He wants to learn what rare natural wonders survive in the region's harshest corners.

sections.title: The Glassy Beasts of the Vale
sections.body: Deep in Stonetalon, the Charred Vale is an ash-choked basin scarred by the Venture Company's devastation. Mauren's studies say a peculiar breed of basilisk once lived there. Ground to fine powder, their scales can catalyze specialized arcane spells he has devised. Mauren does not know whether the basilisks survived the Vale's harsh transformation. So he asks explorers to bring back fresh crystallised scales and learn whether the breed endures.

faq.answer: Collin Mauren is a wizard in Stormwind's Mage Quarter who studies arcane spellcraft and seeks rare reagents from distant lands.

faq.q: Why does Collin Mauren need basilisk scales?
faq.answer: Mauren grinds crystallised basilisk scales into fine dust to catalyze spells he has devised.

faq.q: Where is the Charred Vale located?
faq.answer: The Charred Vale is a ruined basin in southwestern Stonetalon Mountains, on Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is the Charred Vale charred?
faq.answer: The Venture Company's goblins devastated the Charred Vale. Their destruction enraged the vale's spirits and loosed elementals. The ground lies blackened and smoldering, with hardy, twisted beasts roaming it.

faq.q: What creatures drop the scales needed for this task?
faq.answer: Basilisks in the Charred Vale of Stonetalon Mountains have the scales Mauren seeks.

faq.q: Why send an adventurer all the way across the sea for this?
faq.answer: Mauren needs the crystalline properties of basilisks native to the Charred Vale. Crossing the Great Sea is perilous, so he asks seasoned travelers already bound for Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a mage, you know that gathering rare reagents for other wizards supports arcane research. Exotic magical wildlife can provide what is needed to develop new incantations.
As an Alliance traveler, you see Stormwind's interests and supply lines reach deep into Kalimdor's wild territories.
